sections.title: About
sections.content: Join artists Jeremie Gindre and Mirjana Farkas for an evening conversation exploring the intersections of narrative, drawing, and installation across their practices. The pair discuss recurring motifs, collaborative processes, and the ways storytelling shapes their approach to space and material.

sections.title: Ticket Infos and Prices
sections.content: General admission: $15. Members and students: $10. Tickets can be reserved online in advance or purchased at the door subject to availability. Doors open thirty minutes before the talk begins.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: The venue is wheelchair accessible with step-free entry and accessible restrooms. Assistive listening devices are available on request. For specific accommodations, please contact the gallery ahead of your visit.
